targets.query: from(bucket:"pdm-data") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "plc_data" and r._field == "fault") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value == 0 then 1000.0 else if r._value == 1 then 200.0 else 500.0 }))
from(bucket:"pdm-data") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "plc_data" and r._field == "vib_rms") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 20.0 }))

from(bucket:"pdm-data") |> range(start: -1h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "plc_data" and r._field == "fault") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with asset: "Motor-M-101", component: "Drive End Bearing", predicted_failure: if r._value == 0 then "None" else if r._value == 1 then "Inner Race Spalling" else "Outer Race Spalling", rul_hours: if r._value == 0 then 1000 else if r._value == 1 then 200 else 500, priority: if r._value == 0 then "Low" else if r._value == 1 then "Critical" else "High" }))
